property_summary: For any caller who is the current owner and any target newOwner address, calling transferOwnership(newOwner) on the correct contract succeeds (does not revert) and sets owner to newOwner; the mutant adds a require that newOwner == owner(), causing calls that attempt to change owner to a different address to revert (breaking that rule).
change_summary: Add an extra require that newOwner must equal current owner, preventing changes to owner unless same address (so no-op unless same); changes observable owner after call.
